dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A cluster of irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the mid-lateral flank, defined by thin, high-intensity light-gray perimeters that show sharp gradient transitions from the surrounding dark-intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity pixel cores; the texture is primarily defined by thin curvilinear outlines with very few isolated solid-core flecks present near the posterior transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent annular structures on the central-lateral flank form an irregular quadrilateral arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: Intricate interlocking chain-like topology where multiple annular structures appear to share common high-intensity boundary segments on the central flank.
